subject: Re: Pause on inference demo — roadmap shift at Halcyon
messages:
From: Aisha Brown <aisha@halcyonlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Halcyon — request to pause demo scheduling

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We were planning to lock in the full demo for next Thursday but I wanted to flag a short-term change on our side. Our product org just confirmed a hard launch window for a new analytics feature and leadership is reallocating engineering and PM time for the next three sprints. That means we need to deprioritize exploratory projects, including external inference evaluations for now.

Would you be able to place our scheduled demo on hold and remove the calendar invite for the time being? We still think Redwood is interesting — particularly the routing/fallback features — but we need to clear the launch runway. Can we land on a check-in in ~6–8 weeks to reassess?

Apologies for the disruption. I know this affects your team’s scheduling. Happy to connect on next steps if helpful.

Best,
Aisha Brown
Head of Engineering, Halcyon Labs

--
Attachment: Product-Roadmap-Note.pdf (summary, 1 page)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Brown <aisha@halcyonlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Halcyon — request to pause demo scheduling

Hi Aisha —

Totally understand — congrats on the launch window. We can pause the demo and remove the invite. I’ll also flag the HubSpot opportunity as "on hold" and set a 6-week follow-up task.

A few quick asks so we can keep this tidy on our side:
- Can you confirm the preferred recheck timeframe (6 vs 8 weeks)?
- Would you like us to keep the sandbox reserved and the SOW draft we shared (attached) under NDA, or should we mark the materials as inactive until the lift?
- If procurement will need any interim docs (SOC 2 evidence, network diagram) to expedite a later rollout, let us know and we’ll surface them now so you can stash them with the launch docs.

I removed the calendar slot for the 15th and added a tentative follow-up for 2028-03-26 per a 6-week cadence; we can change that.

Thanks — and good luck with the launch.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: SOW-Draft-Halcyon.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Halcyon — request to pause demo scheduling

FYI — forwarding Aisha’s note and my quick status. We should:
1) Move opportunity to "Discovery — On hold" in HubSpot, add reason: "Prospect product launch reallocation."
2) Keep the sandbox reserved (cost negligible) but mark it as dormant; I’ll annotate the SOW with the last shared version and next steps.
3) Offer a one-pager for procurement now so they can attach it to the launch packet (SOC 2 snapshot, retention policy, simple network diagram).

Dev — can you please prepare a short procurement packet (1–2 pages) and a one-paragraph note on typical rollout time for a Dedicated instance? If we get a procurement ping while they’re prepping the launch, we want to avoid project friction later.

Would also like to discuss whether a small courtesy credit or extended trial window is appropriate to keep Halcyon warm — would welcome your recommendation.

Laura Bennett
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

>> On Feb 12, Aisha Brown wrote:
> (see message)

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Halcyon — request to pause demo scheduling

Laura / Jonas —

Got it. I attached a two-page procurement packet and a one-paragraph Dedicated instance rollout summary. The packet includes: SOC 2 snapshot (summary), data retention default, example network diagram, and a short checklist for procurement. I recommend we share that now — low lift for us, high signal for procurement teams.

On the credit: recommend offering a 30% first-month courtesy credit for any Dedicated reservation if they convert within 90 days of the check-in. That’s a modest lever to keep momentum. If you want, I’ll draft the email language to include the offer and next-steps for procurement.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Demo-Runbook-v1.md; Procurement-Packet-ExecSummary.pdf

From: Aisha Brown <aisha@halcyonlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Halcyon Labs Procurement <procurement@halcyonlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Feb 2028 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Halcyon — request to pause demo scheduling

Thanks, team — this is great and much appreciated.

We’ll hold the demo and you can send the procurement packet; procurement may review it in parallel with launch docs. Recheck at 6 weeks (the week of March 26) works best for us. If anything changes sooner (e.g., we get bandwidth earlier) I’ll ping you.

Also, appreciate the proposed credit — procurement will note it in our vendor evaluation folder. No need to formalize now; we’ll come back to it during the check-in.

Best,
Aisha
